svg.text: HBM forward-flow candidate: shared QK/PV compute, real local stores, unfinished boundaries
All panels same 32.984×25.981 mm die / true aspect ratio. Lines show required connectivity; unplaced intermediates prevent timing/routing claims.
K → QK(shared orange) → SC → scale/MAX/EXP → rawE + BF16EB → PV(same orange + localV) → PV/DEN → inverseRoPE
Solid endpoint dots use actual LEF pins where present. Dashed diamonds/lines are unplaced reduction/mux obligations; they are not free wire paths.
QK phase: feature reductions cross fields AND central seams
Representative head0: 2 lanes ×16 featurepartials, 32b/edge each.
All16heads: 16,384 partial bits/edge. Diamonds: TREE UNPLACED.
Query64 partitions fourSL slices/field; 512b/client,128VM reads.
KV/PV phase: same34 mode-local code; localP4 + transpose missing
Green bankt locally feeds QKtile t OR Vtile t after distinct fullreload.
P4: +384SRAM=.410409mm²; global1024b converted write fan4.
Pissue1024b/field; T6402.5MiB quadport traffic remains, now local.
PV drain: local capture → registered gather → SAME NE eight banks
Gather4×4757FF /4759pins, +2edges,11445 nominal roots/group.
128headmajor commits unchanged; 500×450 reservations UNQUALIFIED.
HC/query/P/read/control now reach four physicalNE bank pairs.
Algorithm and outside boundaries: local reductions ≠ global COLL
UNPLACED: SC256 / SU-SFU / MAX-SUM / HC-IDX
589824 transposeFF / PCcontrollers / sink-DEN-norm
Actual clocks, PG, halos, COLL hubs and source head map
NoCOLL inside component QK featuretrees, REDMAX/REDSUM or PVmerge.
Post-o_own Oprojection/COLL is downstream; rank/headmapping OPEN.
Quarterbridge1092tracks/corridor has no actualhubhome/pinroute grant.
Inventory shown:128 realquad outlines /2048PV /34KV /64Q /512P SRAMs;32SMframes,32VMbanks,96LGprototypes,9SerDes/endpoints,4PHYreservations.
Missing realhardware listed above prevents whole-die fit/clock/cut/native-performance closure. White space is unverified. Orange compute is shared by QK/PV phases.
Sources mode34 9cf430e13; Q64 363c3cfaa; P4 4408c92e6; gather adf0ef9d5; quadLEF ac510d59eafc85b5…
Blue=W ld_w actualpin; red=E oy actualpin. All R0; no unqualified flip. Connectivity overlays are diagnostic, not actual routed wires or zero-cycle permissions.
